name: Suzlon Energy Ltd
title: Suzlon Energy Ltd - 532667 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 deliveries of 2,456 MW (+58%) and Q4 commissioning of 332 MW, but order book flat at 5.9 GW and FY27 delivery guidance left to trend language; capex run-rate guided to about INR600 crore.

capex.quote: We would have a run rate of about INR600-odd plus minus 50 going forward.

triggers.label: Q4 commissioning 332 MW vs 95 MW
triggers.quote: We did 95 and this year, same quarter we did 332, that is 250% improvement.

triggers.label: 975 MW erected, not commissioned
triggers.quote: there are almost 975 megawatts of turbines erected and not yet commissioned.

triggers.label: Order book flat at 5.9 GW
triggers.quote: Our opening book was 5, and we are closing at 5.9.

triggers.label: Industry installs 6 GW FY26 to 8 GW FY27
triggers.quote: Our numbers would be more or less plus/minus you can give some leeway, 8 gigawatt in '27 and maybe 10 gigawatt in '28.

triggers.label: EBITDA margin 18.1%, up 100bps
triggers.quote: EBITDA margin expanded to 18.1%, up 100 basis points Y-o-Y.

guidance.quote: Our numbers would be more or less plus/minus you can give some leeway, 8 gigawatt in '27 and maybe 10 gigawatt in '28.
we expect it to continue to grow in FY '27 and ultimately reach 50% in FY '28.
We would have a run rate of about INR600-odd plus minus 50 going forward.
As of now, the number is in the range of about 300, 350.

prior_guidance_check.quote: at the beginning of the financial year, we said that in FY '26, we will have a 60% of growth.

prior_guidance_check.metric: OMS EBITDA recoup by year end
prior_guidance_check.quote: at the end of the year, we achieved the EBITDA of 40.5%.

prior_guidance_check.metric: EPC share rising to 50% by FY28
prior_guidance_check.quote: Now we reached 28% and we expect it to continue to grow in FY '27

red_flags.label: DTA recognition inflating PAT
red_flags.quote: PAT includes a deferred tax asset recognition of INR742 crores for the year FY '26.

red_flags.label: Operating cash flow weak vs EBITDA
red_flags.quote: operating cash flow... is about INR12 billion for FY '26 versus your EBITDA of INR30 billion.

evasions.quote: We cannot give you that number, as I mentioned.
